title: fix(fields): root the capability spec-parity pin at the file, not the cwd (objectui#7791)
body:
Fixes #7791

## The defect and the repair

`packages/fields/src/widgets/CapabilityMultiSelectField.specParity-6285.test.tsx`
read the source it pins through the i18n gate's own `readVocabulary`, rooted at
`'.'` — the process cwd. This package's `test` script is
`vitest run --root ../.. packages/fields/`, which is what
`pnpm --filter @object-ui/fields test` and `turbo run test` both run, and it
leaves cwd at `packages/fields/`: **`--root` moves VITEST's root and moves
nothing about `process.cwd()`.** The read resolved against the package
directory, missed, and the pin threw — a FALSE RED whose message offers three
disjuncts, two of which read as a real regression in
`CapabilityMultiSelectField.tsx`. It actively sent its reader hunting a defect
that was not there.

The root is now derived from the file's own location, five path segments up out
of `import.meta.url` — the same walk the `readVocabulary` import one line above
already spells as `../../../../`, and the same thing both ends of that gate
already do (`scriptDir` in `scripts/check-i18n-call-site-keys.mjs`, `repoRoot`
in `scripts/__tests__/check-i18n-call-site-keys.test.ts`). Root-derived rather
than cwd-derived is the whole property: **the same file must reach the same
verdict under every cwd**, and a cwd-derived root cannot promise that no matter
which invocation the docs bless.

The third disjunct of the failure message moved with it: it no longer names a
cause this file can have.

Not done, deliberately:

- **The package `test` script was not touched.** That would fix one package
  while the `readVocabulary` root convention is shared.
- **The assertion was not loosened to "skip if the file can't be read."** A
  conditional skip is how a case stops running on exactly the machines where it
  would have fired.

## Two shorter spellings, both measured here, both traps

Recorded in the file so the next author does not re-derive them:

| spelling | what happens in this package's `dom` project |
|:--|:--|
| `dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url))` — the form the two files above use | **TS2591 on both `node:path` and `node:url`.** Those two are `.test.ts` in the `unit` project; this is a `.test.tsx`, and `tsconfig.test.json` names no `types` (its header says why that is deliberate). A test file is not the place to change that program. |
| `new URL('../../../..', import.meta.url)` | **Vite rewrites this syntactic form.** Measured in this very file, it evaluates to `http://localhost:3000/@fs/home/user/…` — a dev-server URL — and `fileURLToPath` then throws `ERR_INVALID_URL_SCHEME` under BOTH cwds. It would have turned a false red into a suite that does not load at all. Bare `import.meta.url` is left alone by that transform, which is why it is read on its own and taken apart by hand. |

## Family census — 5 call sites, exactly 1 carried the cwd assumption

`git grep` over `readVocabulary` and `VOCABULARY_ROOT`, whole repo:

| call site | root it passes | cwd-dependent? |
|:--|:--|:--|
| `scripts/check-i18n-call-site-keys.mjs:1937` (the gate itself) | `resolve(scriptDir, '..')`, and `scriptDir` is `dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url))` | no — file-derived |
| `scripts/__tests__/check-i18n-call-site-keys.test.ts:1438` | `repoRoot` = `path.resolve(path.dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url)), '../..')` | no — file-derived |
| `scripts/__tests__/check-i18n-call-site-keys.test.ts:1470` | same `repoRoot` | no — file-derived |
| `scripts/__tests__/check-i18n-call-site-keys.test.ts:1397` / `:1411` | `repoWith(...)`, an absolute temp fixture dir | no |
| `packages/fields/src/widgets/CapabilityMultiSelectField.specParity-6285.test.tsx:116` | `VOCABULARY_ROOT = '.'` | **YES — this card** |

`VOCABULARY_ROOT` as an identifier exists in one file only (2 occurrences, both
in the file this PR changes). **Within the family this card names, nothing
outside this PR's file needs a change** — the siblings that already do it right
are what the repair copies.

### The adjacent family, filed as objectui#7799

A second sweep — tests that build a repo path from `process.cwd()` directly,
rather than through `readVocabulary` — turns up 16 files under `packages/*/src`
(i18n 10, plugin-view 3, plugin-grid 1, components 1, cli 1), and the class is
live, not theoretical. Measured on this tree:
`packages/i18n/src/__tests__/common-search-retired-4392.test.ts` is 5 passed (5)
from the repo root and 2 failed / 3 passed (5) under its own package's script
form, failing with `scan root missing: …/packages/i18n/packages`. Meanwhile
`packages/components/src/__tests__/browser-process-shim-scope.test.ts:69-72`
states the falsified premise in prose, and
`packages/plugin-view/src/__tests__/ObjectView.hostOnlyViewTypes.test.tsx:217-221`
already works around the same hazard with a two-candidate `existsSync` probe.
That is outside this claim's file surface, so it is a card and not a rider on
this PR: **objectui#7799**, no assignee, for triage. Its dangerous half is
untriaged by design — which of the 16 fail loudly and which pass VACUOUSLY, the
false-green direction, needs a per-file reading.

## Readings — both cwds, before and after

All on one tree, one container. After-readings are on this PR's commit
`3b55a4c4e`.

| invocation | cwd | before | after |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| `pnpm exec vitest run packages/fields/` (repo root, the canonical form and CI) | repo root | 133 files / 2178 tests passed | **133 files / 2178 tests passed** |
| `pnpm --filter @object-ui/fields test` (**the acceptance reading**) | `packages/fields` | **1 file / 2 tests failed** | **133 files / 2178 tests passed** |
| single file, package cwd, isolated (`cd packages/fields && vitest run --root ../.. FILE`) | `packages/fields` | 2 failed / 5 passed (7) | 7 passed (7) |
| single file, repo root | repo root | 7 passed (7) | 7 passed (7) |

The two cwds now agree exactly, which is the acceptance property.

Also run on the final commit: `pnpm --filter @object-ui/fields type-check` — exit
0, both `tsc` legs (`tsc --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`), with the
dependency closure built through turbo first (`turbo run build
--filter='@object-ui/fields^...'`, 9/9 successful) because `type-check`
`dependsOn ^build`. `eslint` on the changed file — 0 errors, 2 warnings, both
pre-existing `no-explicit-any` on lines this diff does not touch. Repo gates
`check:control-bytes` (6353 files scanned, OK) and `check:i18n-keys` (the family
this pin guards — 25 families, 18 with a static vocabulary, 113 members checked
exactly) both green.

## Lit control — the case goes red when the derivation goes back to cwd

Mutation leg: the root derivation replaced by `const VOCABULARY_ROOT = '.';`
Confirmed on disk before reading anything — injected text count 1, deleted
identifier count 0, and the blob hash moved
`2807088011…` to `905a4ef4bc…`.

- **Package-dir invocation: RED, and it names itself** — `Test Files 1 failed
  (1)`, `Tests 2 failed | 5 passed (7)`, both failures being
  `reads a non-empty vocabulary, spec array and label table` and
  `declares exactly the spec's capability names, in both directions`. The exact
  pre-fix signature.
- **Repo-root invocation on the SAME mutated tree: 7 passed (7)** — the
  asymmetry that made this a false red rather than a real one.

Restoration proof (the proof is the hash, not that the `trap … EXIT INT TERM`
fired): `git checkout HEAD -- ABSOLUTE_PATH`, then
`git hash-object` on disk = `280708801164d8695d2436651bff2a5a214eb24c` =
`git rev-parse HEAD:PATH`, and `git diff HEAD` empty. The empty-hash case is
treated as FAILURE, not as "nothing to compare". No rebuild was needed for
either leg: the mutation is in the test file itself, which vitest transforms
from disk on every run — no `dist/` sits between the mutation and the reading.

## A fact for a maintainer — AGENTS.md is falsified, and this PR does not touch it

`AGENTS.md` (怎么跑测试) states that `pnpm --filter FIELD test` and `turbo run
test` are 现在是安全的 since objectui#3240, because each package's `test` script
points back at the repo root and therefore reaches 和 CI 同一个结论.

**That claim does not hold for any test whose assertion reads the filesystem
relative to cwd.** objectui#3240 moved VITEST's root; it did not move
`process.cwd()`. This card is the demonstration: the documented package-level
form produced a verdict CI never produces, and an agent is told it may rely on
that form. The direction here is a false RED (costly debugging) rather than a
false GREEN (lost coverage), but the documented equivalence is what is wrong.

`AGENTS.md` is a governed surface: this branch changes **zero bytes** of it, and
this seat neither edits nor approves such a change. Stated here so a maintainer
can decide what the sentence should say.

## Changeset

Test-only, so the changeset declares an EMPTY frontmatter — nothing ships.
`node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs` verdict, verbatim:

```
Compared the working tree with abdcd189c (merge-base with origin/main): 2 file(s) changed, 1 of them published source of a package the release covers, 0 of them a manifest whose published contract moved, 0 under a package changesets ignores, 1 changeset(s) added.
✅  1 source file(s) of 1 released package(s) changed, and this change declares 1 changeset(s): .changeset/7791-specparity-cwd-root.md.
    Every one of them has an EMPTY frontmatter — declared as releasing nothing, which
    is the explicit exemption and a complete answer to this gate.
```

`check-changeset-no-major` and `check-changeset-fixed` are green as well.
